# Copy mode (C4.8): entering and leaving it, scrolling, the position indicator, selections,
# select-word and select-line, copying to a buffer, and the mouse (the wheel, double and triple
# clicks, drags) through tmux's default bindings, compared with tmux.
conf copymode.conf
size 80x24
run new-session -d -s a -n w 'seq 1 40; printf "alpha beta-gamma delta\nsecond line here\n"; exec cat'
waittext %0 'second line here'
client c 80x24
# Enter, scroll, page, the history's top and bottom.
run copy-mode -t %0 ; display-message -p -t %0 '#{pane_in_mode}|#{pane_mode}|#{scroll_position}|#{copy_cursor_x},#{copy_cursor_y}|#{selection_present}'
screen c
run send -X -N 5 -t %0 scroll-up ; display-message -p -t %0 '#{scroll_position}|#{copy_cursor_x},#{copy_cursor_y}'
run send -X -t %0 page-up ; display-message -p -t %0 '#{scroll_position}|#{copy_cursor_x},#{copy_cursor_y}'
screen c
run send -X -t %0 history-top ; display-message -p -t %0 '#{scroll_position}|#{copy_cursor_x},#{copy_cursor_y}'
run send -X -t %0 halfpage-down ; display-message -p -t %0 '#{scroll_position}|#{copy_cursor_x},#{copy_cursor_y}'
run send -X -t %0 history-bottom ; display-message -p -t %0 '#{scroll_position}|#{copy_cursor_x},#{copy_cursor_y}'
run send -X -t %0 cursor-up ; send -X -t %0 cursor-up ; send -X -t %0 cursor-up ; send -X -t %0 start-of-line ; display-message -p -t %0 '#{copy_cursor_x},#{copy_cursor_y}'
run send -X -t %0 cursor-right ; send -X -t %0 cursor-right ; send -X -t %0 end-of-line ; display-message -p -t %0 '#{copy_cursor_x},#{copy_cursor_y}'
run send -X -t %0 nonsense ; send -X -t %0 cancel ; display-message -p -t %0 '#{pane_in_mode}'
run send -X -t %0 cancel
# A selection: begin it, move, copy it to a buffer.
run copy-mode -t %0 ; send -X -t %0 cursor-up ; send -X -t %0 cursor-up ; send -X -t %0 start-of-line ; send -X -t %0 begin-selection ; send -X -t %0 cursor-right ; send -X -t %0 cursor-right ; send -X -t %0 cursor-down
run display-message -p -t %0 '#{selection_present}|#{selection_active}|#{selection_start_x},#{selection_start_y}|#{selection_end_x},#{selection_end_y}'
screen c
run send -X -t %0 copy-selection ; show-buffer ; display-message -p -t %0 '#{pane_in_mode}|#{selection_present}'
# select-word on each kind of word, and select-line; copy-pipe-and-cancel leaves copy mode.
run send -X -t %0 history-bottom ; send -X -t %0 cursor-up ; send -X -t %0 cursor-up ; send -X -t %0 start-of-line ; send -X -t %0 cursor-right ; send -X -t %0 select-word
screen c
run send -X -t %0 copy-selection-no-clear ; show-buffer
run send -X -t %0 cursor-right ; send -X -t %0 cursor-right ; send -X -t %0 cursor-right ; send -X -t %0 cursor-right ; send -X -t %0 cursor-right ; send -X -t %0 cursor-right ; send -X -t %0 cursor-right ; send -X -t %0 select-word ; send -X -t %0 copy-selection ; show-buffer
run send -X -t %0 cursor-right ; send -X -t %0 select-word ; send -X -t %0 copy-selection ; show-buffer
run set -g word-separators '' ; send -X -t %0 start-of-line ; send -X -t %0 cursor-right ; send -X -t %0 cursor-right ; send -X -t %0 cursor-right ; send -X -t %0 cursor-right ; send -X -t %0 cursor-right ; send -X -t %0 cursor-right ; send -X -t %0 cursor-right ; send -X -t %0 select-word ; send -X -t %0 copy-selection ; show-buffer ; set -gu word-separators
run send -X -t %0 select-line ; send -X -t %0 copy-pipe-and-cancel ; show-buffer ; display-message -p -t %0 '#{pane_in_mode}'
# send-keys runs the copy-mode table's bindings: q cancels.
run copy-mode -t %0 ; send -t %0 C-Space ; send -t %0 Up ; send -t %0 M-w ; show-buffer ; display-message -p -t %0 '#{pane_in_mode}'
run send -t %0 q ; display-message -p -t %0 '#{pane_in_mode}'
# The wheel enters copy mode (-e) on a pane that asked for no mouse, scrolls, and leaves at the
# bottom.
type c '\x1b[<64;20;10M'
type c '\x1b[<64;20;10M'
type c '\x1b[<64;20;10M'
run display-message -p -t %0 '#{pane_in_mode}|#{scroll_position}'
screen c
type c '\x1b[<65;20;10M'
type c '\x1b[<65;20;10M'
run display-message -p -t %0 '#{pane_in_mode}|#{scroll_position}'
# A double click copies the word under the mouse, a triple click the line: each enters copy
# mode and leaves it 0.3 seconds later.
type c '\x1b[<0;10;22M'
type c '\x1b[<0;10;22m'
type c '\x1b[<0;10;22M'
type c '\x1b[<0;10;22m'
wait -t %0 '#{pane_in_mode}' == 1
wait -t %0 '#{pane_in_mode}' == 0
run show-buffer ; display-message -p -t %0 '#{pane_in_mode}'
run run-shell -d 0.4
type c '\x1b[<0;3;23M'
type c '\x1b[<0;3;23m'
type c '\x1b[<0;3;23M'
type c '\x1b[<0;3;23m'
type c '\x1b[<0;3;23M'
type c '\x1b[<0;3;23m'
wait -t %0 '#{pane_in_mode}' == 1
wait -t %0 '#{pane_in_mode}' == 0
run show-buffer ; display-message -p -t %0 '#{pane_in_mode}'
run run-shell -d 0.4
# A drag selects from the press to the release and copies it.
type c '\x1b[<0;3;21M'
type c '\x1b[<32;6;21M'
type c '\x1b[<32;9;22M'
screen c
type c '\x1b[<0;9;22m'
wait '#{pane_in_mode}' == 0
run show-buffer
# With mode-keys vi: the cursor stops on the last character, and selections take it in.
run set -g mode-keys vi ; copy-mode -t %0 ; send -X -t %0 history-bottom ; send -X -t %0 cursor-up ; send -X -t %0 cursor-up ; send -X -t %0 start-of-line ; send -X -t %0 select-word ; send -X -t %0 copy-selection ; display-message -p -t %0 '#{copy_cursor_x},#{copy_cursor_y}'
run show-buffer
run send -X -t %0 start-of-line ; send -X -t %0 begin-selection ; send -X -t %0 cursor-down ; send -X -t %0 end-of-line ; display-message -p -t %0 '#{copy_cursor_x},#{copy_cursor_y}'
screen c
run send -X -t %0 copy-selection-and-cancel
run show-buffer
run kill-server
